Guideline: Use packages/yolo-gpui bridge for Zed GPUI and Longbridge GPUI-Component
Description: yolo-gpui unifies Zed gpui-fast, Longbridge gpui-kit (60+ GPU widgets), rust-i18n, and YoloThemePreset tokens
Do: Depend on yolo-gpui from the workspace for GPU-accelerated desktop apps
Don't: Mix conflicting upstream gpui git revisions in the same binary

Guideline: Use gpui-component widgets for complex desktop UI
Description: submodules/gpui-kit provides 60+ GPU-rendered components including DockArea, Table, VirtualList, Input, Modal, Charts and resizable panels
Do: Build workspace chrome with gpui_component::dock::DockArea and Button/Input primitives
Don't: Re-implement text editing, virtual scrolling or docking from raw GPUI quads

Guideline: Map YoloThemePreset to gpui::Rgba via RgbaColor
Description: yolo_shared::RgbaColor::to_u32_rgba() packs normalized colors into 0xRRGGBBAA expected by gpui::rgba()
Do: Convert YoloThemeTokens and M3 roles through yolo_gpui theme helpers
Don't: Scatter literal gpui::rgb(0x1e1e2e) hex constants across view render methods

Guideline: Use GPUI Tailwind-style fluent builder methods
Description: GPUI's Styled trait exposes flex(), flex_col(), gap_2(), p_4(), rounded_md(), items_center() backed by Taffy
Do: Chain GPUI Styled methods aligned with the 4px/8px spacing grid
Don't: Compute manual pixel offsets in paint callbacks for standard flex layouts

Guideline: Use uniform_list or VirtualList for large collections
Description: Rendering thousands of GPUI elements per frame without virtualization wastes GPU quad buffers and layout time
Do: Wrap lists with 50+ items in gpui::uniform_list or gpui_component::VirtualList
Don't: Render all vec items directly inside div().children(...) on every frame

Guideline: Use Entity<T> and Context<T> with cx.notify()
Description: GPUI manages retained state in Entity<T> handles; mutations inside update() must call cx.notify() to schedule a frame
Do: Mutate model state via entity.update(cx, |model, cx| { ...; cx.notify(); })
Don't: Hold Arc<Mutex<T>> for UI state or forget cx.notify() after state changes

Description: Heavy I/O, parsing or indexing on the foreground thread stalls 120fps GPU rendering
Do: Offload work to cx.background_executor() and hop back with cx.spawn()
Don't: Block inside Render::render or input event handlers
Code Good: cx.spawn(|this, mut cx| async move { let res = cx.background_executor().spawn(job).await; })

Guideline: Bind actions with KeyBinding and focus_handle
Description: GPUI dispatches typed Action structs through the focused FocusHandle hierarchy
Do: Declare actions! macro types, bind them in Keymap, and attach track_focus(&self.focus_handle)
Don't: Match raw key strings in on_key_down without focus scoping

Guideline: Load Zed Plex / JetBrains Mono fonts via font-kit
Description: submodules/zed-fonts and submodules/font-kit provide crisp subpixel GPU glyph rasterization
Do: Register workspace fonts at startup and use rem/px typography tokens from YoloStyle
Don't: Rely on missing system fallback fonts for code or tabular metrics

Guideline: Inspect GPUI element trees and awesome-gpui patterns
Description: Use GPUI Inspector and submodules/awesome-gpui to debug bounds, focus handles and GPU quad batches
Do: Launch bun ui devtools gpui to inspect element hierarchy and shader overdraw
Don't: Debug layout overlaps by adding temporary colored borders in production code
